replicate.name: Replicate
replicate.notes: Replicate publishes a monochrome symbol only; no SVG symbol on replicate.com, so the lobe-icons mirror is used.

huggingface.name: Hugging Face
huggingface.notes: Official full-colour face from Hugging Face's own site CDN.

fireworks.name: Fireworks AI
fireworks.notes: Current official site icon. The background tile <rect> was dropped and the viewBox cropped to the tile's inner area; path data untouched. Its colour is near-black #280016, so it ships as currentColor for dark themes (the older purple #5019C5 mark is superseded).

together.name: Together AI
together.notes: Matches the three-circle favicon served on together.ai.

openrouter.name: OpenRouter
openrouter.notes: Official v2 lockup; only the glyph path (fill #7624F4) is kept and the viewBox is set to a square around it. Wordmark paths removed, glyph path data untouched.

cerebras.name: Cerebras
cerebras.notes: Orange arcs at #F15A29; the inner C uses currentColor so it adapts to light and dark themes.

qwen.name: Qwen
qwen.notes: Checked against the qwen.ai favicon (blue #082dff mark).
